hostname n1
feature bgp
interface Ethernet1/1
  description x1
  no switchport
  ip address 198.51.100.1/30
  no shutdown
interface Ethernet1/2
  description isp
  no switchport
  ip address 203.0.113.1/30
  no shutdown
interface Ethernet1/3
  description lan
  no switchport
  ip address 203.0.113.65/26
  no shutdown
ip route 203.0.113.128/26 Null0
ip prefix-list ISP-OK seq 5 permit 198.51.100.128/25 le 32
route-map FROM-ISP permit 10
  match ip address prefix-list ISP-OK
  set local-preference 150
router bgp 64501
  router-id 192.0.2.11
  log-neighbor-changes
  address-family ipv4 unicast
    network 203.0.113.64/26
    network 203.0.113.128/26
  neighbor 198.51.100.2
    remote-as 64502
    description x1
    address-family ipv4 unicast
  neighbor 203.0.113.2
    remote-as 64499
    description isp
    address-family ipv4 unicast
      route-map FROM-ISP in
